content: Godot 4 introduces a new global class system for GDScript. Use class_name to register a class in the editor.
Signals in Godot 4 use the new Callable syntax. Example: button.pressed.connect(_on_pressed)
Tweens in Godot 4 are now node-independent. Use create_tween() to animate properties.
Warning: The `load()` function is synchronous. Use ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request for async loading.
